data.businessDescription: Castellum AB engages in the construction, developing, and marketing of commercial properties through new construction, reconstructions and extensions, and acquisitions. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Stockholm, West, Central, Malardalen, Oresund, and Finland. The company was founded on September 24, 1993, and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Autotrader Group Plc engages in the digital automotive business. It sells cars, bikes, vans, motor homes, caravans, and trucks. It also offers automotive insurance products. It operates through the following business segments: Auto Trader and Autorama. The Auto Trader segment refers to the advertising of motor vehicles, and other related products and services. The Autorama segment relates to leasing of new vehicles, and other related products and services. The company was founded by Robert John Madejski in 1977 and is headquartered in Manchester, the United Kingdom.

Solvay SA engages in the manufacture and distribution of chemical and plastic products. It operates through the following segments: Basic Chemicals, Performance Chemicals, and Corporate and Business Services. The Basic Chemicals segment is involved in chemical intermediate businesses focused on mature and resilient markets. The Performance Chemicals segment focuses on formulation and application expertise through customized specialty formulations. The Corporate and Business Services segment includes corporate and other business services, such as group research and innovation. The company was founded by Ernest Solvay in 1863 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

Electrolux AB engages in the manufacturing of home and professional appliances. It operates through the following georapical segments: Europe, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and Africa; North America, and Latin America. The company was founded by Axel Wenner-Gren on August 1, 1919, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Autoliv, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of automotive safety systems. Its products include airbags, seatbelts, steering wheels, inflators and initiators, textiles and webbing, commercial vehicle and electrical safety solutions, motorcycles and bikes, pedestrian protection, and test services. The company was founded by Lennart Lindblad in 1953 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Storskogen Group AB engages in the acquisition and management of portfolio of companies. It focuses on the industrial, services, and trade sectors. The company was founded by Daniel Samuel Kaplan, Carl Alexander Murad Bjargard, and Ronnie Bergstrom in 2012 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Partners Group Holding AG engages in investments in private markets with growth and development potential. It operates through the following segments: Private Equity, Private Debt, Private Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Royalties. The Private Equity segment includes investments made in private from non-publicly traded companies. The Private Debt segment provides debt financing for private companies. The Private Real Estate segment is involved in investments made in private real estate assets. The Infrastructure segment focuses on private infrastructure assets. The Royalties segment refers to investments made in private markets royalties. The company was founded by Alfred Gantner, Marcel Erni, and Urs Wietlisbach in 1996 and is headquartered in Baar, Switzerland.

data.businessDescription: Grifols SA is a global specialty plasma therapeutics company that engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of a broad range of biological medicines based on plasma-derived proteins. It operates through the following segments: Biopharma, Diagnostic, Bio Supplies, and Others. The Biopharma Segment includes all activities related with products deriving from human plasma for therapeutic use. The Diagnostic Segment deals with the marketing of diagnostic testing equipment, reagents, and other equipment. The Bio Supplies segment consists of all transactions related to biological products for non-therapeutic use. The Others segment focuses on the rendering of manufacturing services to third party companies. The company was founded by José Antonio Grifols i Roig in 1909 and is headquartered in Barcelona, Spain.

Nomad Foods Ltd. operates as a holding company, which manufactures and sells frozen foods for human consumption. Its products are offered under the brands LUTOSA, la Cocinera, Birds Eye, Iglo, and Findus. The company was founded by Noam Gottesman and Martin Ellis Franklin on April 1, 2014 and is headquartered in Woking, the United Kingdom.

NCC AB is a construction and property development company. It operates through the following segments: NCC Infrastructure, NCC Building Sweden, NCC Building Nordics, NCC Industry, NCC Property Development, and Other. The NCC Infrastructure segment supplies end-to-end infrastructure projects, including tunnels, roads, and railways, covering design, construction, production, and maintenance. The NCC Building Sweden and NCC Building Nordics segments construct residential buildings, offices, public facilities such as schools and hospitals, and commercial properties including stores and warehouses. The NCC Industry segment produces stone materials, asphalt, and paving solutions. The NCC Property Development segment develops and sells commercial properties in metropolitan regions across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.

Rai Way SpA is engages in the management and development of the terrestrial broadcast infrastructure, which carries the television and radio signals of Rai. It also offers management of transmission, terrestrial and satellite broadcasting of signals, tower rental, and network services. The company was founded on July 27, 1999 and is headquartered in Rome, Italy. [Ultimate parent per FactSet: Italy]

Ebro Foods SA is engaged in the manufacturing, processing, marketing, research, import, and export of all kinds of food and dietary products. It operates through Rice Business, Fresh and Premium Dry Pasta Business and Other Business segments. The firm's products include rice, pasta, cereals, and diet products. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain.

Kingfisher plc engages in the provision of home improvement products and services through a network of retail stores and other channels. It operates through the following geographical segments: UK and Ireland, France, Poland, and Other. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

data.businessDescription: Karnov Group AB engages in the provision of information in the areas of legal, tax and accounting, and environmental, health and safety. The firm offers legislation, case law, regulatory information, news, and continued legal education services. It operates through the following segments: North, South, and Group Functions. The company was founded in 1867 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Dürr AG engages in the business of mechanical and plant engineering, which focuses on automation and digitalization. It operates through the following divisions: Paint and Final Assembly Systems, Application Technology, Clean Technology Systems, Industrial Automation Systems, and Woodworking Machinery and Systems. The Paint and Final Assembly Systems division plans and builds paint systems and final assembly lines for the automotive industry and supplies software for the over-arching production control. The Application Technology division develops and manufactures products and systems for the automated application of paint, sealants, and adhesives. The Clean Technology Systems division specializes in exhaust gas purification systems and energy efficiency technology. The Industrial Automation Systems division comprises the automation technology and balancing, diagnostic, filling, ang tooling technology business areas. The Woodworking Machinery and Systems division develops and produces machinery and systems for the woodworking industry. The company was founded by Paul Albert Dürr in 1896 and is headquartered in Bietigheim-Bissingen, Germany.

Ottobock SE & Co. KGaA engages in the research, development, manufacture, and distribution of medical technology products. It offers Prosthetics, Orthotic, and Exoskeletons solutions. Its products include C-Leg 4, C-Brace, Dynion, MyCRO Band, and Ottobock Microprocessor Knees. It provides Ottobock professional website, iFab, and GreenLine services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and Americas Asia Pacific (APAC). The Europe, EMEA, and APAC segments refer to the manufacturing and distributing of prosthetic, orthotic, and neurostimulation products. The company was founded by Otto Bock in 1919 and is headquartered in Duderstadt, Germany.

Breedon Group Plc is a holding company, which engages in the business of quarrying aggregates and manufacturing and selling construction materials and building products including cement, asphalt, and ready-mixed concrete. It operates through the following segments: Great Britain, Ireland, and Cement. The Great Britain segment includes construction materials and surfacing businesses in Great Britain. The Ireland segment focuses on Island of Ireland. The Cement segment is involved in cementitious operations in Great Britain and Ireland. The company was founded on August 15, 2007 and is headquartered in Breedon on the Hill, the United Kingdom.

data.businessDescription: LDC SA engages in the production, packaging, and marketing of poultry products. It operates through the following divisions: Poultry and Catering. The Poultry division includes poultry production, pork, cattle and rabbit activity, collect of cereals and agricultural supplies; and egg activity. The Catering division offers a range of products, such as ready meals, pizzas, pancakes, exotic meals and sandwiches. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Sable-sur-Sarthe, France.

Arkema SA engages in manufacturing and supplying chemical products. Advanced Materials, Adhesive Solutions, Coating Solutions, Primary Materials, and Corporate. The Advanced Materials segment offers innovative solutions with high added value to meet the major challenges of sustainable development, including lightweighting, new energies, access to water, bio-based products, and recycling. The Adhesive Solutions segment supplies technologies used in building activities for businesses and individuals, including sealants, tile and flooring adhesives and waterproofing systems, and technologies. The Coating Solutions segment focuses on the broad range of innovative products for decorative paints, industrial coatings and adhesives, and provides solutions for applications in the paper industry, superabsorbent, and water treatment. The Primary Materials segment includes businesses of global acrylic monomers, legacy refrigerants, and hydrogen peroxide. The company was founded by Thierry le Hénaff on January 31, 2003 and is headquartered in Puteaux, France.

Antin Infrastructure Partners SA operates as a private equity firm, which engages in applying a differentiated investment approach to the nascent infrastructure asset class. The company was founded by Alain Rodger Rauscher and Mark Crosbie in 2007 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
